name: BRAIN EXTRACTION APP TEST 10/26/26
summary: Test App that skull-strips a T1-weighted image with FSL BET.
description: Test registration of a scaffolded App: a wrapper fills a command template from config.json and runs brain_extract.py, which calls FSL bet with the chosen fractional intensity threshold and optional robust centre (-R) and bias/neck cleanup (-B). As written, the template passes --robust and --bias-neck-cleanup with a value although the script defines them as flags, and the output path comes from a 'brain' config key, so runs are expected to fail; use a production BET App instead.

outputs.description: Brain-extracted (skull-stripped) T1-weighted image from FSL BET.
